description: Remediates the deferred CLAUDE-AUTH-005 finding from the Claude Opus 4.8 merge-audit dump: backend/frontend status surfaces use a wide vocabulary (READY, ADMITTED, ACCEPTED, AUTHORIZED, ALLOWED, ...) and an operator or downstream agent might equate READY with AUTHORIZED. This lock introduces an 8-class disjoint authority vocabulary (capability_available, evidence_present, request_pending, admission_present, approval_present, execution_authorized, source_mutation_authorized, training_eligible) and a canonical classifier (scripts/repair/ready_authorized_vocabulary.py) that maps every known status token to exactly one class. Hard invariants: (1) no READY token classifies into a class that implies authorization; (2) no fixture-only approval token classifies as source_mutation_authorized; (3) no frontend surface token classifies into an authorization-implying class; (4) no existing token classifies as training_eligible. SOURCE_MUTATION_APPLIED_AFTER_APPROVAL is the single token in source_mutation_authorized and only the apply gate may emit it.
